checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan: add Digit Span as an experimental verbal working-memory focus test with indirect, explicitly bounded evidence

impact_assessment.benefits: Adds a genuinely new, safe, static game; broad WM meta-analyses support task-practice framing without transfer claims.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Mirror the spatial engine, keep no flashing or audio, update every mechanic list, add failing-first tests and verify gameplay in Edge.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new MechanicId touches types, schema, engine dispatch, UI stage, adaptive storage and script/test mechanic lists; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no evidence-count changes
impact_assessment.why: Verbal digit span is a distinct working-memory construct not covered by N-back, Corsi or paired associates, and the app could offer another claim-bounded focus test.
